_note: Active archive missions. These are real documents that need more IPFS mirrors.

missions.title: US Constitution — Congressional Archive
missions.desc: constitution.congress.gov returned 403 errors in July 2025. The document must not exist only at government URLs.
missions.why: Constitutional documents are primary targets for erasure. Every copy is a vote for historical record.
missions.pin_guide: Paste the CID into Pinata (free tier), Filebase, or your local IPFS node.

missions.title: Federal Spending Transparency Data
missions.desc: DOGE-related data purges removed public federal spending records. Courts ordered partial restoration but data remains incomplete.
missions.why: Accountability data — once deleted, historical spending patterns disappear from public record.
missions.pin_guide: Download datasets from USASpending.gov and pin to IPFS. Document your CID in Guardian chat.

missions.title: From Dictatorship to Democracy — Gene Sharp
missions.desc: Foundational guide to nonviolent resistance. Used by democracy movements in 30+ countries. Must survive indefinitely.
missions.why: This document has helped topple dictatorships. It must never be unavailable.
missions.pin_guide: Download the PDF, add to IPFS, verify the CID matches, pin and share.

missions.title: CISA Security Advisories Archive
missions.desc: Cybersecurity alerts and threat bulletins. Post-CISA-layoffs (130+ dismissed Feb 2025), institutional knowledge is at risk.
missions.why: Security advisories protect critical infrastructure. Their erasure leaves communities blind.
missions.pin_guide: Use the WebRecorder extension to archive CISA advisory pages, then pin the WARC file to IPFS.

missions.title: Evidence of Voter Suppression Incidents 2024–2026
missions.desc: Documentation of voting rights incidents, court filings, and firsthand accounts that must be preserved regardless of who controls official archives.
missions.why: Those who control the archive control the history. Distribute the copies.
missions.pin_guide: Submit documented evidence via the Guardian Chat (#investigation channel). Include source URL and date.
